strategies.name: FVG_Trend_Continuation_Entry
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a Fair Value Gap (FVG) that occurred during a period of high momentum and a break of structure. Enter when price retraces and taps into the FVG.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just outside the FVG (below for buys, above for sells) and allow the trade to run with the trend.

variants.transcript_quote: So once that FVG is created, all you just need to do is patiently wait for price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure.
